Deck names are worked out from the cards actually played: matches are
grouped by the Pokemon seen, and each group is named after the one
that does the attacking. That keeps working when a set drops, because
nobody has to tell it anything.
Add an entry here only to force a particular name -- if the automatic
one is wrong and it bothers you. A deck matches when every card in
'requires' was seen AND at least one in 'requires_any' was seen:
Anything listed here wins over the automatic name.
